mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 10-year average signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% (10-year average), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) relative to the prior quarter signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 and HOUST are both declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) relative to the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month average signals robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When annual inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.5%, it signals a loss of central bank control over price stability, prompting aggressive rate hikes that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) relative to the prior month signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST are both declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to the prior quarter signals an economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and INDPRO is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is less than 0.03.
